### Featured Articles

#### Building an AI Copilot for Accounts Receivable: A Technical Deep Dive
URL: https://joanis.co/blog/building-ai-copilot-accounts-receivable
Topics: Python, FastAPI, LangChain, AI, Gemini, React, FinTech
Summary: How we built an AI copilot at Delfyn that transforms how finance teams manage accounts receivable. Covers ReAct pattern implementation, LangChain agent architecture with Gemini 3, tool wrapper patterns, Redis conversation memory, streaming responses, and assistant-ui frontend integration.

#### Building a Flexible SSO Authentication System: OAuth2 & SAML2 in Rails
URL: https://joanis.co/blog/building-flexible-sso-authentication-system
Topics: Ruby on Rails, OAuth2, SAML2, Authentication, Enterprise Security
Summary: Deep dive into building a multi-tenant SSO system supporting both OAuth2 and SAML2 protocols, enabling seamless integration with enterprise identity providers like Azure AD, Okta, and OneLogin.
